appliedUpdates.description: Updated architecture.md tool count from 8 to 11, adding update_library, configure_environment, and web_search. Added environment.json, library/, and skills/ to State Files section.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add convention: Any code that mutates .pi/missions/library/ content must call clearProtocolCache() afterward to ensure the orchestrator protocol reflects updated library content.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Three separate locations (spawn-worker.ts, update-library.ts, web-search.ts) all independently call clearProtocolCache() after library mutations. This pattern was established across 3 features (spawn-and-learn, update-library-tool, m2-cross-area-integration) but is not documented anywhere. A new tool that appends to the library without clearing the cache would silently serve stale protocol prompts.

rejectedObservations.observation: TOPIC_NAME_RE regex duplicated in library.ts and update-library.ts
rejectedObservations.reason: Acceptable duplication — the library module throws errors for programmer mistakes while the tool returns error results for runtime errors. Both need independent validation at their respective levels.

rejectedObservations.observation: isHeaderOnly regex limited to single-word headers
rejectedObservations.reason: All default library topics use single-word headers. Custom topics with multi-word names are not currently supported. Non-blocking edge case.

rejectedObservations.observation: Lint command targets only extensions/ directory, test files not linted
rejectedObservations.reason: This is existing convention from AGENTS.md and services.yaml. Changing the lint scope is outside this milestone's scope.

rejectedObservations.observation: web_search returns structured details while other tools return empty object
rejectedObservations.reason: Non-blocking style divergence. The structured details pattern is arguably better but changing all existing tools is outside scope.

rejectedObservations.observation: DuckDuckGo API knowledge not recorded in library
rejectedObservations.reason: This is implementation detail of a single tool. Not useful as project-wide knowledge since only web-search.ts uses it.
